_comment: Statistical deviation bands (z = standard deviations from this crew member's own baseline) and co-deviation patterns for decision support. These are software settings chosen for a simulated prototype, NOT clinical thresholds. Edit and restart to change behaviour.

cardiovascular.label: Cardiovascular
cardiovascular.description: Heart rate, blood pressure, rhythm regularity and heart-rate variability.

respiratory.label: Respiratory
respiratory.description: Oxygen saturation and breathing rate, with simulated cabin CO2 when an environmental scenario runs.

thermoregulation.label: Thermoregulation
thermoregulation.description: Body temperature, with simulated cabin temperature when an environmental scenario runs.

sleep_circadian.label: Sleep and circadian
sleep_circadian.description: Last night's sleep against this crew member's recent nights, and sleep-schedule adherence.

activity_recovery.label: Activity and recovery
activity_recovery.description: Exercise volume against the plan and resting heart rate against recent days.

radiation.label: Radiation exposure indicators
radiation.description: Simulated crew dose and real NASA space-weather indicators (context only, never converted into dose).

patterns.label: Concurrent cardiovascular and respiratory deviation
patterns.review: Review heart and breathing signals together; check sensor contact and the activity log.

patterns.label: Temperature and cardiovascular signals deviating together
patterns.review: Review temperature and heart-rate trends together with activity and cabin conditions.

patterns.label: Sleep shortfall alongside cardiovascular deviation
patterns.review: Review recent sleep with resting heart-rate and variability trends.

patterns.label: Sleep shortfall alongside reduced activity or recovery
patterns.review: Review sleep and exercise schedule adherence over the last days.

patterns.label: Respiratory and temperature deviation together
patterns.review: Review breathing, saturation and temperature together, including cabin conditions.

patterns.label: Simulated cabin CO2 deviation with respiratory change
patterns.review: Review cabin atmosphere data with the life-support team alongside crew breathing rate.

patterns.label: Space-weather indicators active while simulated dose is elevated
patterns.review: Co-occurrence only: real NASA indicators are context and are never converted into crew dose.
